entry.title: Saudi Arabia strikes oil depots in Yemen and says missiles launched toward location of Saudi Aramco HQ
entry.summary: Saudi Arabia has launched a series of strikes on a strategic oil depot on the outskirts of Yemen’s capital, Sana’a, while later on Tuesday it said it had intercepted missiles launched toward Dharan, location of the headquarters of the huge national energy company Saudi Aramco. The attacks on both sides were a fresh escalation of the conflict between Riyadh and the Iran-backed Houthi forces. Before its offensive on Tuesday, a Saudi spokesperson warned civilians to leave the target area, in an apparent attempt to strike fear into the local population before the biggest attack so far on Houthi energy infrastructure. The Central Sabaha Station oil depot on the western side of the city contains large tanks that often hold substantial quantities of fuel derivatives, although the Yemeni Oil Company said its storage facilities were empty at the time of the attack. Houthi oil depots at the Ras Isa port in Hodeidah, the subject of Israeli attacks in 2024, were also struck in 10 waves of attacks apparently aimed at immobilising the Houthi army as it continues its push south, including towards the city of Taiz. Earlier the Saudis also struck what they believe to be a Houthi leadership hide-out in the Bani Mu’in area in the Razih border district, west of Saada governorate, northern Yemen. The strike on the oil depot appeared to be the Saudi response to a Houthi attack on King Khalid international airport in Riyadh on Saturday that killed 13 people and left 300 injured. 关键事实：Saudi Arabia has launched a series of strikes on a strategic oil depot on the outskirts of Yemen’s capital；while later on Tuesday it said it had intercepted missiles launched toward Dharan；location of the headquarters of the huge national energy company Saudi Aramco

entry.title: US Army targets 2028 for first high-energy laser counter-drone weapons
entry.summary: The first directed energy weapon selected by the U.S. Army for the Enduring-High Energy Laser (E-HEL) program could be out of testing and ready for counter-drone operations by early 2028, Army officials told Military Times at the Association of the U.S. Army’s annual meeting in Washington. “We would love to be able to keep the first unit off the line for our testing and training. However, what we’ve seen is, with the environment as it is, everything that we produce as a capable counter-UAS system tends to get deployed somewhere,” said Kirk Williams, chief engineer at the U.S. Army Directed Energy Project Office. In September, the Army awarded AeroVironment a $464.8 million contract for LOCUST X3, its modular, palletized high-energy laser system. Earlier generations of the LOCUST system are actively fielded in operational environments, including at the U.S. southern border, according to AeroVironment. The first LOCUST X3 is slated for delivery by Q4 of FY 2027 and will be mounted on the Joint Light Tactical Vehicle. The goal is to push it through testing, validation, verification and “give it to soldiers as soon as possible,” said Brig. Gen. Guy Yelverton, capability program executive for Defensive Fires. “My far-down point would be spring [2028], and if I could get in the December-January timeframe, that would be awesome. That would be a great win for the Army.” It is unclear where the first high-energy counter-drone weapons under H-ELS will be deployed. Yelverton suggested the 7th Infantry Division could be a potential partner. 关键事实：The first directed energy weapon selected by the U.S；Army for the Enduring-High Energy Laser (E-HEL) program could be out of testing；ready for counter-drone operations by early 2028

entry.title: Allies did not warn Kyiv of Russian ballistic missile strikes, says Zelenskyy
entry.summary: Ukraine received no early warning from its partners about a second night of Russian ballistic missile strikes on civilian infrastructure in Kyiv, including a critical power plant struck after dark, Volodymyr Zelenskyy said on Tuesday. The Ukrainian president had earlier described an attack involving five missiles on Monday as “particularly vile”. He emphasised that receiving intelligence from Ukraine’s western allies “helps saves lives, and this is one of the most critical issues”. “This is precisely what helps prevent people from being killed – when there is an early warning about ballistic missiles,” he wrote on social media. He did not apportion blame for the lack of warning, calling it unfortunate. Earlier the president claimed Moscow and Kyiv had agreed an “energy ceasefire”, something Zelenskyy described as “news to me”. Ukraine’s leader said his military had not struck Russian oil refineries or energy facilities in the two days following Trump’s Sunday announcement. Ukrainian commanders say American intelligence is not needed to identify targets for deep strikes on Russia, with oil refineries marked on Google Maps. But they say it plays a crucial role in warning of Russian ballistic missile launches, and the takeoff of long-range bomber aircraft. “It is deeply unfair that they are destroying our energy infrastructure while Ukraine receives no warnings about ballistic missile launches,” Zelenskyy said in a statement after the Tuesday strikes. “It is vital that the world does not remain silent about this. 关键事实：including a critical power plant struck；Volodymyr Zelenskyy said on Tuesday

entry.title: Army re-evaluating munitions procurement goals as Iran war continues
entry.summary: The Army\u2019s procurement goals for critical munitions could be shifting, officials said Tuesday in a break from the U.S. government\u2019s typical reticence to talk about the enormous expenditure of weapons during the Trump administration's war on Iran. Increasing annual production of Patriot air defense missiles, particularly the PAC-3 Missile Segment Enhancement, is high on the priority list, Gen. Frank Lozano, the Army\u2019s fires portfolio acquisition executive, said during a panel at the AUSA annual meeting in Washington, D.C.\u00a0 关键事实：The Army\u2019s procurement goals for critical munitions could be shifting；officials said Tuesday in a break from the U.S；government\u2019s typical reticence to talk about the enormous expenditure of weapons during the Trump administration's war on Iran

entry.title: NVIDIA Announces New Investments in France’s Startups
entry.summary: Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements NVIDIA’s Investments in France NVIDIA has been investing in France’s startup ecosystem, having previously invested in leading technology companies including Alice&Bob, Gradium and Scintil Photonics . Across all of Europe, NVIDIA has committed nearly $10 billion to the technology ecosystem. Today, NVIDIA announced new planned investments in Doctolib, Entalpic , Genesis AI and Pigment . These startups are innovating to solve challenges across healthcare, materials discovery, physical AI and business planning. Doctolib , a European healthcare technology company, builds agents that free up healthcare professionals to deliver better care, while providing patients with a digital health companion that improves access to care and supports more preventive, continuous medicine. Entalpic , a Paris-based startup, accelerates the engineering of advanced materials at the atomic scale, with particular expertise in surfaces and interfaces for semiconductor manufacturing and next-generation electronics. Genesis AI is a global robotics company developing general-purpose robots with frontier intelligence and capabilities through its foundation models, data collection systems, simulation infrastructure and robot hardware. Pigment , a Paris-based enterprise software company, builds a planning platform that helps businesses forecast performance, model scenarios and make decisions across finance, sales, workforce and operations. Sovereign AI Infrastructure France-based companies are expanding agentic infrastructure on NVIDIA technology. 关键事实：Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements NVIDIA’s Investments in France NVIDIA has been investing in France’s startup ecosystem；having previously invested in leading technology companies including Alice&Bob；Scintil Photonics

entry.title: US Army assesses Trust Automation’s integrated drone defence system
entry.summary: Trust Automation has completed a US Army operational assessment of its Small-Unmanned Air Defense System (SUADS) during a National Training Center rotation at Fort Irwin, California. Conducted with the 703rd Brigade Support Battalion, 2nd Armored Brigade Combat Team, 3rd Infantry Division, the assessment evaluated SUADS in a large-scale combat operations training environment under ongoing uncrewed aerial system (UAS) threats. During the rotation, Trust Automation’s SUADS detected and engaged UAS between approximately two and six kilometres away, with potential coverage extending to approximately seven kilometres under favourable conditions, the company said in a 12 October press release. Interview participants were not aware of any enemy UAS that penetrated the defended area as a threat within the identified operational ranges without first being detected by the system. Trust Automation’s integrated system combined radar, electro-optical/infrared (EO/IR) sensors, NINJA and DroneBuster technologies. MAJ Patrick Smith, Battalion Executive Officer said the system consistently provided layered surveillance, early warning, positive target identification and electronic defeat of hostile UAS before enemy systems could successfully conduct reconnaissance, target acquisition or attack missions. SUADS brings multiple sensors and effectors into a single integrated system while enabling individual technologies to be added or upgraded as capabilities and threats evolve. Trust Automation is also developing a mobile SUADS variant to support tactical units where forces move frequently. 关键事实：Conducted with the 703rd Brigade Support Battalion；2nd Armored Brigade Combat Team

entry.title: NASA JPL Testing Readies Voyager Technologies Lander for Moon Mission
entry.summary: 4 min read Preparations for Next Moonwalk Simulations Underway (and Underwater) Engineers and technicians use a crane to position Voyager Technologies’ Griffin-1 lunar lander within the 25-Foot Space Simulator at NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory on Aug. 31. The spacecraft recently completed a series of rigorous environmental tests at JPL ahead of launch to the Moon later this year. NASA/JPL-Caltech The testing team moves Voyager Technologies’ Griffin-1 through a hallway to the 25-Foot Space Simulator at JPL. 关键事实：4 min read Preparations for Next Moonwalk Simulations Underway (and Underwater) Engineers；The spacecraft recently completed a series of rigorous environmental tests at JPL ahead of launch to the Moon later this year

entry.title: Increasing Russian jet-powered drones require “innovative interception capabilities” – Ukraine’s MoD
entry.summary: The ministry said Russia is increasing its use of jet-powered drones that fly at speeds of around 400 km/h, reducing the time available to detect and intercept them. In addition, it is seeing small groups of several jet-powered drones being sent to different regions. Ukraine said it is developing “innovative interception capabilities” to add an additional layer to its air defence to counter this tactic. Ministry of Defence of Ukraine 关键事实：The ministry said Russia is increasing its use of jet-powered drones that fly at speeds of around 400 km/h；reducing the time available to detect；intercept them
